notes: Single-stage: implement a stdlib HTTP client that walks a full stateful session (single-use challenge nonce with deployment-varying hash algorithm, cookie-name-agnostic session jar, optional X-Nonce header, CSRF-protected logout) and saves a report artifact. Verified by executing the client against fresh hidden origins (sha512/header-required, sha1/plain, sha256/header-required) and checking the exact issued sid/csrf plus server-side session termination. Rubric nonzero for interaction_statefulness and hidden_case_generalization (session state must be carried across four calls under varying deployments), reasoning_depth (dynamic alg dispatch), debugging_ambiguity (single-use nonces, header variant), adversarial_inputs (failing challenges need a fresh nonce), quantitative_correctness (exact session values). No tool breadth or dependency chain; totals bucket to medium.
